title: Mary D Shared NDE and NDE 2563
content: These may not qualify as NDE's as I was not the person dying. In the first experience, I was at a summer camp experience with my friend, Bunny, and her family. We decided to go swimming in the lake early evening. She didn't like to feel the mud on her feet so she wore tennis shoes. She dived off the diving board; I was still on shore and could see she was having a very hard time surfacing. At that moment, it was instantaneous thought, I could see a long dark tunnel and Bunny was going down it. I knew she was going to die. I remember saying 'No,' and going into the water to save her. It felt like a tremendous fight between light and dark. It felt like I was fighting light and dark. I was finally able to get her to shallow water so she could stand up. She thanked me profusely and made me promise never to tell anyone of what happened - I didn't. This is the first time I have ever told anyone about that experience. The second experience, again, may not qualify as a NDE. My grandmother was in a nursing home, she was ninety-eight with Alzheimer's. She was from the 'old country', Ukraine, and spoke very little English even though she was in America as a young girl. I had gone to visit her the previous weekend. Nothing out of the ordinary, but the next weekend, late Friday evening/Saturday morning (12:20 am) I have a vision of her in stars like a rocket ship ascending into the skies. Spirits who tell me I must stay where I am - it is a very beautiful sight - dark blue with silver and gold shooting stars, they surround grandma and she is smiling. I wake gasping for breath and, with the vision in my head. I know grandma has died. I call my parents and they tell me grandma died last night, I tell them I know. They tell me she died at 12:20 am. I tell them what I experienced. Background Information: Gender: Female Date NDE Occurred: two experiences 1962 and 1990 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Yes Accident Illness Other 1. My friend was drowning 2. my grandmother died My friend was drowning. My grandmother died. How do you consider the content of your experience? Mixed Did you feel separated from your body? Yes I lost awareness of my body How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? More consciousness and alertness than normal It was like processing many thoughts all at the same time and all very distinct, the energy level around me was rushing by, but my actions seemed to be very slow within this energy field. All my thinking was very fast and very precise. It was like I was moving and thinking at one speed yet that was not the real speed as everything else around me was rushing by. I can still remember every detail of each experience. At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? While I was in the midst of the experience. How I got there and back is not as intense as being in the middle of it and experiencing that incredible light and darkness. Were your thoughts speeded up? Incredibly fast Did time seem to speed up or slow down? Everything seemed to be happening all at once Both experiences felt out of time. Were your senses more vivid than usual? Incredibly more so Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere? Neither Did you pass into or through a tunnel? Uncertain I had a profound sense of enclosure by darkness so dark it enveloped me - and the light was also a very bright distinct entity. Did you see any beings in your experience? Saw them Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? Yes In my experience with my grandmother I met spirits. They were celebrating and laughing as my grandmother traveled up through the silver and gold stars - they also told me I had to go back, it couldn't go any farther. Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin Did you see an unearthly light? Yes Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? Neither What emotions did you feel during the experience? Wonder and amazement. Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Incredible peace or pleasantness Did you have a feeling of joy? Neither Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? United, one with the world Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? Everything about the universe Did scenes from your past come back to you? Neither Did scenes from the future come to you? Neither Did you come to a border or point of no return? A barrier I was not permitted to cross; or 'sent back' to life involuntarily God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Liberal Have your religious practices changed since your experience? No What is your religion now? Liberal Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? No Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? Definite being, or voice clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin Did you see deceased or religious spirits? Saw them Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? No Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? No After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? Yes It took place in what felt like another dimension that no words can describe. Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? No I have always been very psychic. Are there one or several parts of your experience that are especially meaningful or significant to you? The dying process is very beautiful. There is some existence after death, in what form I'm not sure - maybe those spirits were friends and family welcoming her. Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes One, no - the first experience with my friend. One yes, with my mother and father. My mother was very psychic and just nodded her head like yes, I understand. My father didn't really pay attention. It was his mother who had just died. Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? No What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real Matter of factly. What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real I know there are many dimensions of existence - these experiences were there. So close, as if just walking over a threshold. At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? No

out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Reported: 'I lost awareness of my body.'

arrival.other_being_detail: Described as 'spirits' celebrating and laughing; told her she must stay where she is and could not go farther.

environment.environment_other_detail: Vision of grandmother 'in stars like a rocket ship ascending into the skies' with 'dark blue with silver and gold shooting stars' surrounding her; grandmother smiling.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Two experiences: (1) friend drowning (accident) and (2) grandmother's death while in nursing home (illness/age-related).

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Two distinct experiences; first involved perceiving friend 'going down' a long dark tunnel and a 'fight between light and dark' while rescuing her; second involved a star-filled ascent vision of grandmother with spirits telling her she could not go farther.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Not provided as a clear ordered sequence; described as instantaneous perceptions/visions during two separate events.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Experiencer states she was not the one dying; first event: perceived friend's trajectory down a dark tunnel while friend was drowning; described a 'tremendous fight between light and dark' during rescue. Second event: vision of grandmother ascending among dark blue sky with silver/gold shooting stars, surrounded by spirits celebrating; woke gasping and later learned time of death matched (12:20 am).
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "I could see a long dark tunnel and Bunny was going down it."; "It felt like a tremendous fight between light and dark."; "I have a vision of her in stars like a rocket ship ascending into the skies."; "Spirits who tell me I must stay where I am"; "The dying process is very beautiful."; "It took place in what felt like another dimension that no words can describe."
